title: Low degree mass outside influential coordinates
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to $\\{-1,1\\}$, let $\epsilon,\eta>0$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. If the total influence $I(f)$ is positive, set $\tau=(\epsilon I(f)^{-1}(\eta/(2+\eta))^k)^{1+\eta}$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients over sets $S$ with $|S|\le k$ that are not contained in the coordinates whose influence is at least $\tau$ is at most $\epsilon$.
